fields.name: showDigitalClock
fields.label: Show digital time
fields.description: Show the digital time beneath the analog clock.

fields.name: clockFit
fields.label: Clock size
fields.description: Standard leaves room around the clock; Full screen fills the shortest display dimension.

fields.name: showWhiteOutline
fields.label: Show white outline
fields.description: Show the thick white ring around the clock face. When hidden in full-screen mode, the clock expands toward the display edge.

fields.name: rainbowStyle
fields.label: Rainbow style
fields.description: Choose the rainbow treatment behind the clock.

rainbowClockJSX.name: Rainbow Clock JSX
rainbowClockJSX.description: Draws the rainbow analog clock as an ESP32-safe JSX SVG image.
